messages.content: Maya Chen from Analytics here, with request IT-001 dated 2026-10-22. Can I get new read access on Atlas in staging from 2026-10-23 to 2026-11-06? My manager is Priya Shah. I'm checking the weekly conversion dashboard with the new event definition changes (before next reporting cycle). The sample records are already loaded, and I need to check the totals against our spreadsheet. Once I'm done with checking, I'll be sending out any discrepancies to the dashboard owner.

response_handling.success: Validate completion marker, extraction JSON, supplied schema and literal quotes before review routing.
response_handling.missing-credential: Set API_KEY in the operator environment, then retry; no HTTP request was sent.
response_handling.timeout: Request timed out after bounded retries; check provider availability and retry this document.
response_handling.rate-limit: Provider rate limit exhausted the retry budget; wait for capacity and retry this document.
response_handling.unavailable: Provider connection or server failed after bounded retries; restore service and retry this document.
response_handling.http-error: Provider rejected the HTTP request; check endpoint, credentials, model access and configuration before retrying.
response_handling.refusal: Provider refused extraction; inspect the source and provider policy before retrying.
response_handling.incomplete-response: Provider response was interrupted or did not finish; inspect output limits and retry.
response_handling.malformed-json: Provider returned malformed JSON; inspect the provider configuration and retry.
response_handling.schema: Extraction failed the supplied schema; inspect the model configuration and retry.
response_handling.invalid-envelope: Provider completion envelope was invalid; check endpoint compatibility and retry.
response_handling.invalid-quotes: Extraction contained a quote absent from the message; inspect the source and retry.
response_handling.provider-error: Provider reported an error without usable facts; check service configuration and retry.
response_handling.invalid-export: Source must be a readable UTF-8 JSON object with a message string; repair the export and retry.
response_handling.mock-exhausted: No mock response remained; extend the explicit mock script and retry.
